description.narrative: The Project entails a proposed IFC A Loan investment of up to USD20 million in Woda Metal Industry Plc. (Woda) based in Ethiopia. Woda will be the beneficiary of the IFC funds. The use of proceeds is for permanent working capital requirements to support Wodas manufacturing expansion of its steel-based power transmission and telecommunication towers and cables in Ethiopia.

The proposed investment aims to support electrification and connectivity efforts in Ethiopia, which are important due to the growing population and infrastructure developments. The primary expected project-level outcomes include economy-wide and environmental effects. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will enhance the resilience of the local steel structure and cables value chain to better support critical infrastructure and the expansion of the telecom and power industries in Ethiopia.
